text.p: Interpublic Group of Cos Inc's McCann-Erickson unit said it acquired The Weber Group Inc, a Cambridge, Mass.-based public relations company with more than $15 million in annual income.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Following the acquisition, Lawrence Weber, chairman and chief executive of Weber Group will assume the same title at McCann-Erickson's public relations group, charged with developing McCann's public relations business worldwide.

Weber, ranked as the fastest-growing public relations firm among the Top 20 by O'Dwyer's Directory, specializes in high technology and has a large office in Palo Alto, Calif. It is the nation's 8th largest independent public relations firm.
Interpublic also said it acquired a related firm, Thunder House, an interactive marketing firm, a sister company of Weber, also based in Cambridge.
